decisions.reason: After two years the glass flake spraying system has had time to show some demand, but as a niche extension built on existing spraying technology with likely modest carrying costs it still retains enough option value to keep on the market.

The low-pressure material transfer pump is a multi-model product line closely embedded in the firm's established capabilities and customer applications, so its strategic fit and reuse of components make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Because the hydraulic two-component spraying system is a very recent launch close to the core offer, uncertainty about its full market potential is still high while the cost of keeping the option open should be relatively low.
